commentary: Someone asked what Westeros looks like in 2048 — and then **just built it**

credit.name: @evolving.ai
credit.note: original creator unnamed in the source

caption:
Game of Thrones never ended. Westeros ran on to 2048.

Winterfell has a skyline behind it. The Ironborn raid on motorbikes instead of longships. A maester steps off a helicopter. The North still holds, it just holds with armour columns now.

What makes this worth twenty seconds isn't the effects. It's that the question and the answer used to be separated by a studio, a greenlight and three years. Somebody thought "what would this look like" and then simply went and looked.

That gap closing is the whole story of the last two years, and it is not really about film. Every idea you have ever had that died at "who would build that" is sitting in the same position this was.

Clip via @evolving.ai — the original creator isn't named in the source. If you know who made it, tag them and I'll credit properly.
